verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs refer to an in-builder preview where you can make visual edits directly (bolt-docs-44). The GitHub README says Bolt runs Node.js servers and tools like Vite in the build environment (bolt-gh-1, bolt-gh-2), which implies a running app you can preview before publishing to bolt.host (bolt-docs-32). A community user describes a working app built in about 15 minutes (bolt-comm-4). missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of an interactive live-preview pane (clicking through and testing app behavior, not just visual edits), and hands-on corroboration of using the preview before publishing.
